matched.failure: An app with the default etag setting calls res.set('Transfer-Encoding', 'chunked').send('hello') for a GET. Before this change the response carried an ETag. matched.title: Numeric-index merge mutates the parent's req.params object
matched.failure: A parent route `app.use('/user/id:(\\d+)', router, handler)` with a `mergeParams` router whose child route is `/*.*`. The child's numeric keys '0','1','2' are written into the parent's params object. When the router calls next(), `handler` sees req.params containing the router's merged keys even though the router was supposed to be scoped. The non-numeric branch avoids this by merging into `obj`, so the two branches behave differently.
